top_choice_rationale: Aberration correction removed a fundamental electron-optical constraint and created a mature, independently established atomic-scale observational capability with broad, durable impact across materials physics. Subject to archival confirmation of the proposed allocation, Rose, Haider, and Krivanek provide a coherent account of the decisive conceptual and practical advances.
